M29 Phase F5 RML23 23-class live -- correctness fix delivery (conformance golden rebuild + 4 integration items)
================================================================================================================
Status: M29-RML23-LIVE-CORRECTNESS-FIX-READY-FOR-BOARD-TEST (NOT correctness PASS / HARDWARE_PASS)

What this round fixes
---------------------
Board gate `run_gate9_rml23.sh --phase=offline --count=240` previously failed with
match_rate=0.000000 because deployment_golden/ still carried the M22 12-class golden
(different model / different label contract / different input source), incomparable
with the 23-class RML23 output. This round rebuilds a dedicated RML23 conformance
golden from the frozen expA_bf16_head product (24 source classes x 10 = 240 frames),
plus 4 integration leftovers (one-click start/stop, RML23 socket alignment, 1000 ms
steady-clock state heartbeat, state protocol version rml23-chain-v2).

Conformance golden is a deployment-consistency reference, NOT an accuracy eval.
match_rate is never described as "model accuracy". 1000/10000-frame results are
relabelled runtime-stability-only (NOT a correctness gate).

Verification (all offline, board untouched)
-------------------------------------------
  - Both tarballs unpacked to fresh temp dirs and `sha256sum -c` on their embedded
    manifests returned OK for every file (FULL_SELFCHECK_OK / PATCH_SELFCHECK_OK).
  - gen_rml23_golden.py: merged-23 argmax == frozen expA_pred23_ref_i32.bin over all
    1536 frames (0 mismatch); main set strictly 24 source classes x 10, covering BPSK
    and QPSK; expected_argmax.tsv f[1] in 0..22.
  - test_golden_rml23.cpp (17/0) + verify_golden_rml23.py positive + 8 negative cases.
  - Full host suite green (test_control_channel 71/0 with rml23-chain-v2 + model_sha).
  - offline gate >=0.90 must be confirmed ON BOARD by the user via
    run_gate9_rml23.sh --phase=offline --count=240; host self-consistency does not
    substitute for that.

Red lines honoured: no model retrain, no RTL/XDC/bitstream/Flash change, no real TX,
no match-rate lowering, no failed-sample removal; no NPU_PASS/RML23_LIVE_HARDWARE_PASS/
UI_HARDWARE_PASS/PROJECT_COMPLETE/FINAL_* written.

Task B (UI visual redesign) is a SEPARATE, deferred patch and is NOT included in this
round's diff/patch/package (no ui_render/ui_layout/font/snapshot/pixel changes here).
